name: David Gadyan
headline: Forward Deployed Engineer | Agentic AI Systems in Production | AI Consultant
summary: AI engineer and consultant with 8 years, 180+ delivered projects and 50+ long-term clients — every engagement customer-facing, from scoping to production and hand-over. Ships agentic systems that run in production: LangChain/LangGraph agents with MCP tool use into CRMs and external APIs, incl. a HIPAA-compliant underwriting agent (turnaround days → minutes).

entries.heading: Upwork (Freelancer)
entries.subheading: AI Engineer / Data Scientist — independent consultant, customer-facing delivery
bullets: 8 years, 180+ projects for 100+ clients worldwide (50+ long-term); Upwork Expert-Vetted (top 1%), $500k+ earned, 8,700+ hours — working directly with CEOs, CPOs, CFOs and managing partners (references on portfolio).

**[Virgil.ai — agentic health-insurance assistant](https://davitgadyan.github.io/portfolio_app/portfolio/project-34/)** — Built the production agent backend (LangChain + FastAPI + OpenAI, MCP tools, Docker/Kubernetes on AWS) with broker partner One Health: user onboarding, medication-coverage lookup and underwriting under HIPAA controls; underwriting cut from days to minutes.

**[LangGraph multi-agent document review](https://davitgadyan.github.io/portfolio_app/portfolio/project-28/)** — Extended a law firm's due-diligence API with a LangChain + LangGraph multi-agent workflow on Gemini: user-defined checks instead of hard-coded prompts, ABN/ACN API validation, long-contract processing, Word report generation; handed over with docs and a replication package.

**[S1mple.ai](https://davitgadyan.github.io/portfolio_app/portfolio/project-33/)** — Created an agentic AI platform (LangChain + GPT-4o, React) with custom tools and MCP support connecting client data, management and trading systems; extended it into an [AI lead-scoring engine](https://davitgadyan.github.io/portfolio_app/portfolio/project-35/) with MCP connectors into HubSpot/Monday/Zoho and PostgreSQL/MySQL/Supabase/MongoDB (Next.js, Kubernetes).

**[Technical lead for a client's AI team](https://davitgadyan.github.io/portfolio_app/portfolio/project-25/)** — Consulted and mentored the client's AI engineers to build and deploy a hybrid recommender as a REST API on GCP; the team shipped it and runs it today in the live Chilldays app.

**[AI real-estate development platform](https://davitgadyan.github.io/portfolio_app/portfolio/project-30/)** — Delivered end to end for a home builder: MLS scraper, XGBoost valuation model and a pro-forma engine scoring hundreds of lot-and-home-style scenarios with zoning and quota constraints enforced; handed over with full documentation and reproducible code.
